name: MagicLab MagicBot Gen1
summary: MagicBot Gen1 is MagicLab's 174 cm, about 70 kg full-size humanoid with a 42-DoF body and optional 11-DoF tactile hands. It is aimed at industrial assistance, logistics, research and customer service. MagicLab has shown groups of robots training on inspection, transport and assembly at an electronics factory.
sensors: 3D LiDAR, depth camera, three fisheye cameras, microphone and speaker.
compute: 8-core CPU with a 100 TOPS AI processor.
highlights: Max joint torque of 350 N·m or more.
December 2024 footage showed several units on inspection, material transport, assembly and barcode scanning at an electronics factory (Robozaps).
MagicBot units reportedly sold out on JD.com after a Spring Festival Gala appearance in February 2026 (Robozaps).
caveats: Factory robots were described as still in the skill training phase with human oversight.
